name: Tokyo 24-ku
source:
Protagonist Sonogi Akihiro is a second-term member of the House of Representatives from the Kyoto district, representing the centrist Democratic People’s Party. He won votes with his looks and youth, helping the ruling coalition secure a majority in the House of Councillors.

In late April, as Golden Week approached, a large-scale car explosion occurred at Shibuya’s scramble crossing. Based on the nature of the blast, Prime Minister Sanjo and the Japanese government judged it to be a terrorist attack and established an anti-terrorism task force.

With the International Athlete Festival (IAF) scheduled for August 2020, and with neither the perpetrator nor the motive known, the government was forced to hurriedly implement additional counterterrorism measures.

And so, in the wake of this incident, Sonogi was compelled to take action.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/story.html]the official website[/url].]
translation:
主人公其扇晟尋是京都选区选出的众议院议员，现处于第二个任期，代表中间派民主人民党。他凭借外貌与年轻形象赢得选票，帮助执政联盟在参议院取得多数。

四月底，黄金周即将到来之际，涩谷十字路口发生大规模汽车爆炸。根据爆炸情况，三条隼人与日本政府判断这是一起恐怖袭击，并成立反恐特别工作组。

国际运动员节（IAF）定于2020年8月举行，但凶手与动机都尚未查明，政府被迫匆忙实施额外的反恐措施。

于是，爆炸事件发生后，其扇不得不采取行动。
